newsitem.title: SWEDEN: NCC buys part of Rasmussen & Schiotz.
newsitem.headline: NCC buys part of Rasmussen & Schiotz.

text.p: Swedish construction and real estate company NCC AB said on Monday it was acquiring all the shares in the Danish contracting operations of Denmark's Rasmussen & Schiotz.
"The purchasing price is DKK 310 million, after the seller has contributed DKK 150 million to the company," NCC said in a statement.
Rasmussen & Schiotz's contracting operations would be combined with those of NCC's subsidiaries Armton, NCC Ejendomme and Poulsen & Co, it said.
"Thus forming Denmark's largest construction company by a broad margin, with combined sales of nearly four billion DKK in 1995," NCC said.
Rasmussen & Schiotz's technical operations director Kaj Kristensen would be the president of the new company, it said.
